videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests; a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: As the first weekend of the busy season kicks off at the Golden Nugget, a missing $1,000 chip sparks a high-tech and hotel-wide hunt to find the person who took it; gaming surveillance cracks down on a team of card counters hitting Fremont Street casinos; tempers flare at the hotel check-in line and a confrontation puts security on alert and a VIP host pulls strings to keep a high roller happy and gambling after he goes on a six-figure winning streak.

videos.title: Gold Rush: White Water
videos.description: As winter starts to show its teeth, Dustin and his crew fight to find bedrock and the $100,000 in gold he needs to avoid selling his claims; a burnt-out winch causes rocks to pile up in the dive hole increasing tensions between Dustin and Danielle.

videos.title: Along Central Asia's Great Rivers
videos.description: Arriving at the dry seabed of the shrinking Aral Sea, Kate makes the first-ever bicycle journey around its shores.

videos.title: Live to Farm
videos.description: Go inside the lives of America's top farmers as they navigate the challenges, risks and rewards of modern agriculture; from planting to harvest, follow real farming families as they work to produce the food that feeds the world.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: Serving others is a noble cause, unless it's in the service industry; between bad customers and broken machines, it can be a total nightmare.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: By land, air, rail or sea -- with so many ways to travel, one'd think it would be a breeze; but leave it to fellow travelers to bring one to one's knees, causing unexpected turmoil along the way.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: The average person spends nearly 90,000 hours of their life at work; from contractor showdowns and unexpected explosions to battling coworkers, a workday feels like an epic rollercoaster ride.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: When jewel thieves get stuck in a shop, a fleeing carjacker hides in a port-a-potty, and a criminal tries to escape in a 20-ton construction vehicle, the law fights back and puts them behind bars.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: Security cameras in front yards, backyards, storefronts and street corners capture crimes, mishaps and earth-shattering moments like break-ins. When lives are at risk, it is up to local law enforcement and communities to save the day.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: In the world of air travel, crime and misconduct are skyrocketing, causing unruly travelers to be denied boarding; protesting passengers create turbulence for everyone on board; when mechanical issues arise, the real chaos begins.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: Holidays highlight unique traditions, but when clashing personalities and lots of alcohol get mixed, mayhem and memorable stories are sure to follow.

videos.title: Caught!
videos.description: Shopping trips are part of everyone's daily routines, but if tensions flare between angry customers and fed-up workers, it can result in more than just damaged goods.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above; a VIP host loses her most valuable client and puts all her hopes of making her monthly quota on a walk-in whale.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: A big music festival takes over Las Vegas and brings nearly-naked guests, packed rooms and non-stop partying to the Nugget; a disturbance call in the hotel sparks tension between guests as a desperate chip thief risks returning to the casino to cash in.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: The annual blackjack tournament lures more than big money to the Nugget; it becomes an opportunity to nab notorious thieves; while a VIP host faces a crowd-shy high roller, security hunts down a slot thief and sets a trap for a serial hotel room burglar.

videos.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
videos.description: A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests; a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: Diving into Lake Superior, Josh has brand-new intel that may finally solve a 100-year-old mystery: the resting place of two WW1 minesweepers; on their way to combat German mines in the Atlantic, the warships sank and took the lives of 79 sailors.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: Josh digs deep into the swamp to hunt the lost fortune of notorious bootleggers and bank robbers the Ashley Gang; Josh needs to retrace the outlaw family's criminal empire, which included a blood feud with the local Florida sheriff.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: In a two-part investigation, Josh Gates travels the globe attempting to solve the most fundamental mystery of all humanity's origins.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: Josh Gates travels to Africa to get up close and personal with a distant relative and scales dangerous cliffs all to figure out where humans come from.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: Josh chases the treasure of legendary Viking Harald Bluetooth Gormsson; the discovery of a mysterious gold artifact sends Josh on a journey through Scandinavia and into remote northern European forests to uncover Bluetooth's tomb and fortune.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: Josh helps recover the richest stash of lost treasure in the Americas; deploying cutting-edge technology and an armada of boats, the team dives the Caribbean to bring coins and jewels from the legendary Spanish galleon Maravillas to the surface.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: Josh Gates treks into Colombia's deadly jungle to unravel the El Dorado myth and retrace the steps of Spanish conquistadors; Josh meets with the tribe that inspired the legend of a city of gold and unearths its treasure in a surprising location.

videos.title: Expedition Unknown
videos.description: The hunt for El Dorado is Josh's most grueling journey ever, and one of the crew tumbles into a raging river; when cutting-edge aerial scans reveal a lost city, the crew pushes into the jungle to uncover El Dorado and the gold that comes with it.

videos.description: Dozer Dave bets his life savings that he can unearth piles of gold from an abandoned mine using salvaged equipment and a team of amateur miners.

videos.title: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
videos.description: Dave faces a nightmare scenario when the ground he's mining goes cold and no one knows why; with his season hanging in the balance, the pressure mounts for Dave to get them back on the gold.

videos.title: Moonshiners
videos.description: For America's 250th anniversary, Tim and Tickle produce revolutionary-era moonshine; Digger questions Mark's attempt at his ancestor's sour corn whiskey; Josh and Jerry's plans fail.

videos.title: Moonshiners
videos.description: As Tim and Tickle add molasses to their 18th-century mash bill and heat their vintage copper still with wood fire, Howard takes the revolutionary spirit too far. Demand for Josh's shine outpaces supply as Jerry opens a new front in his war with Mike.

videos.title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
videos.description: Captures the skill, determination and passion it takes to succeed in one of Louisiana's most demanding outdoor professions; from predawn starts and the relentless search for fish to battling Mother Nature, these guides face pressure every day.

videos.title: Tomorrow's World Today
videos.description: George sends Greg to the World of Innovation for a behind-the-scenes look at a modern steelmaking facility, where cutting-edge technology and a new generation of skilled professionals are transforming one of America's most essential industries.

videos.title: Gold Rush
videos.description: A virus rips through Parker's camp; Tony's son Mike breaks through icy overburden at the Hester Cut; Buzz buys an ancient trommel buried in the bush.

videos.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
videos.description: A rare northern outbreak draws veteran chasers across the Canadian border into unfamiliar territory. Back on home turf, Freddy, Tanner, and Connor race across Nebraska in pursuit of a powerful, long-lived twister that earns the title Tornado of the Year.

videos.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
videos.description: Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

videos.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
videos.description: Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley; they self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way and help save lives when disaster strikes.

videos.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
videos.description: Six teams of chasers pursue a violent tornado outbreak in North Dakota; but as day turns to night, the storm unleashes the first EF5 tornado in over a decade; as the mile-wide monster levels homes and farms, chasers race to rescue people and pets.

videos.title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
videos.description: Matt's tactics spark tension in another camp; survivalists compete in a primitive axe challenge; after the first big-game kill, a competitor must choose to keep or share their win; physical and mental strain of the challenge sends a survivalist home.

videos.title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
videos.description: Pushed to the brink, three competitors send shockwaves through the Outback; all camps are disbanded and challenges going forward will be solo tests; hunting competition offers a protein reward; medics are called when a survivalist steps on hot coals.

videos.title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
videos.description: In a rocket stove challenge, a worst-to-first comeback by a dark horse secures a critical asset; a survivalist gets a big-game kill and plots to shift the balance of power; a top contender's shocking exit rocks the competition.

videos.title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
videos.description: The friction fire challenge shakes everyone; Patrick is stunned when he must give up his gathered materials; Cheeny has an edge, but her strategy risks it all; Matt's blistered hands could send him home; one survivalist is eliminated.

videos.title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
videos.description: With the $100,000 prize on the line, the final gauntlet of challenges tests each survivalist's bushcraft, bow and fire-making skills; the competition is neck-and-neck, with all three competitors seconds from claiming the title of Last One Standing.

videos.description: Shawn hunts for a new spot as the fleet tries to pick up the pieces after the devastating storm; Chris faces horrible visibility issues underwater; Team Emily manages to get back on the gold, and Reaper Nation tries to salvage their season.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: On Lake Sam Rayburn, a water patrol turns into a cry for help; the wardens serve a warrant to a man who illegally shot a hog; a drug arrest leads a game warden into a manhunt.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: It's summertime in Texas and the game wardens handle a speeding jet ski, drunk boaters, angry campers and a rowdy raccoon.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: A feisty gator in Galveston County needs a new home; shrimpers try to conceal their catch; a family's property is damaged by stray bullets; the wardens stage a boat crash.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: It's snapper season on the Gulf and the game wardens catching fishermen who are breaking the law; two men are investigated for cruelty to a wild pig; a jet ski collision leads to arguments; an exotic tortoise finds a new home.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: In Liberty County, the death of a deer is investigated; fawns in Harris County are being illegally kept as pets; patrol on Somerville Lake leads to multiple citations; a suspicious car is stopped in Red River County.

videos.title: Lone Star Law
videos.description: A deer poacher is busted, a baby rattlesnake is rescued, a hummingbird evades capture, and a raccoon is released into the wild; the wardens also respond to flooding conditions and a car accident.

videos.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
videos.description: As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

videos.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
videos.description: Big Al's Towing races the clock as a semi carrying an expensive frozen load overturns on I-80. Stauffer's Towing faces a marathon rescue mission for a propane truck on a steep mountain road. Mountain Recovery clears a hauler blocking mountain traffic.

videos.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
videos.description: A windstorm near Salt Lake City overturns a semi with a mystery load; a hauler with a heavy-duty load of data center cooling units spins out of control on I-80; Mountain Recovery's rookie operator fights a multi-front battle as a midwinter storm hits.

videos.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
videos.description: A once-in-a-lifetime recovery of a mangled truck 300 feet down the sheer drop of the San Juan mountains puts Mountain Recovery on edge. A windstorm rollover in Wyoming sends a semi into the cable barrier with recovery crews caught in interstate traffic.

videos.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
videos.description: A man crosses with something that fell from the sky, literally, as well as the remains of a federally protected animal; officers find a stay-at-home mom who may have a side hustle dealing pills and a shipment of limes arrives with an extra surprise.

videos.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
videos.description: Officers make a massive seizure after searching a spicy load; a former teacher is surprised to find she has an arrest warrant; two men are caught with gun parts in their luggage; a traveler's cargo is scrutinized when crossing liquor into the U.S.

videos.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
videos.description: A retiring officer makes a significant bust before hanging up his hat; a bus arrives with more than just passengers in tow; a mother wanted on a nine-year-old warrant for theft is apprehended; a car unexpectedly explodes in the middle of a bridge.

videos.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
videos.description: Millions of travelers cross the U.S. borders every year. And while some are innocent couples, others are partners in crime. Because at the border, love isn't always what it seems.

videos.description: As they pursue profit, drug cartels are constantly adapting -- hiding deadly narcotics where few would ever expect to find them. The cartels often manufacture fake products to help smuggle items across the border. CBP officers are always on the lookout.

videos.description: As cameras follow the work of Grand Rapids patrol officers, Deputy Chief Joe Trigg must navigate the chaos of a high-stakes series of shootings, high-speed chases and standoffs.
